blocker: LLM response can appear infinite because backend treats HTTP stream EOF as completion instead of Ollama done=true terminal frame.
fix_direction: On ChatToken{done:true}, append final token if present, collect usage/final metadata, emit terminal event, persist message/receipt, and break immediately. Do not wait for EOF.

blocker: Terminal done is not emitted as part of chat:token; UI depends on separate chat:done emitted late.
fix_direction: Make terminal event explicit: either emit chat:token with done:true exactly once, or emit chat:done immediately on done frame; define one contract and test it.

blocker: Partial streamed output is not durably persisted if provider times out/errors after tokens.
fix_direction: Persist a GenerationState row before streaming starts; append/commit partial content on every material chunk or on bounded intervals; mark completed/cancelled/partial_timeout/provider_error terminal state.

blocker: Stop streaming can create local frontend partial while backend provider may continue and later emit done/error.
fix_direction: Make stop_chat backend-authoritative: cancellation token per generation, provider stream aborted, backend emits cancelled terminal event and persists partial exactly once. UI only renders backend state.

blocker: Background summary jobs can hold GPU/LLM gates and make chat appear hung even when Ollama is healthy.
fix_direction: Introduce priority leases: foreground chat preempts/cancels/degrades background LLM work before waiting; background must use short cancellable slices and never hold GPU across long provider calls.

blocker: Gate wait can look like infinite chat because waiting state is not a terminal/output state and SLOs are too high.
fix_direction: Expose streaming phase state to UI with elapsed time, holder owner, cancel button, and hard UX SLO warnings.

blocker: Ollama reqwest client has a 300s total body timeout, which conflicts with app-level streaming deadlines.
fix_direction: For streaming requests, remove global total timeout or override per request; enforce provider_start, first_token, stream_idle and max_wall_clock in application logic.

blocker: Timeout receipt claims static/path coverage but live timeout fixture was not exercised.
fix_direction: Make live timeout fixture mandatory for release gate or mark release blocked.

blocker: Max tokens are hardcoded to 2048.
fix_direction: Add generation_max_tokens to settings DB/API/UI with validation bounds; include effective value in GenerationReceiptV1 and provider body num_predict.
validation_command: cargo test -p gloss generation_max_tokens_setting && npm test

blocker: messages table has no generation status, status reason, partial flag, or continuation lineage.

blocker: Frontend error path may discard partial streaming content.
fix_direction: On backend error/timeout, UI must preserve partial until backend terminal event says partial persisted/continuation available.

blocker: Frontend creates assistant message locally on stop, risking mismatch with backend DB.

blocker: send_message returns immediately with assistant_message_id, not generation acceptance/start status.
fix_direction: Return GenerationAcceptedV1 with attempt_id, queue_state, backend will emit lifecycle events; UI must render queued vs streaming.

blocker: GenerationReceiptV1 lacks finish reason / terminated_by / done_seen_at / eof_seen / partial flags.
